tool_args.rationale: The five observations show a nonmonotonic combined response, but do not separately identify substrate and gradient effects. The open-branch probe can distinguish competing mechanisms before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a sink-gradient model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The coupled variation of u_now and s_grad leaves competing response mechanisms insufficiently identified.
The pilot already covers the target horizon; a branch-discriminating probe is cheaper and more directly addresses the ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
